5.title: Offer lookup at checkout
5.body:
**User story** — As a shopper, my cart prices fast and never applies an expired offer.

**Acceptance criteria**
- AC-1: Expired offers are excluded from pricing.
- AC-2: Pricing a cart answers within 1 s at p95 at production scale.
5.author: paul
